description: This file contains Jest test cases for the i18n (internationalization) features of a React frontend application, including language switching, localStorage persistence, and integration with Wikipedia API URL generation.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by clearing localStorage and resetting the language to English.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for UI updates on language switch, persistence of preferences, Wikipedia URL behavior, and cache key differentiation.
